headline: Ministry of Finance to lead implementation of the Scheme to improve national credit ratings until 2030
summary: The government assigned the Ministry of Finance to lead the organization and implementation of the scheme to improve national credit ratings until 2030. The ministry will report results to the Prime Minister.
why: Sovereign credit ratings influence how much a government pays to borrow, so a formal plan to improve them matters to bond investors.
